name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen lighting upgrade during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen lighting upgrade during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen lighting upgrade during a renovation depends on its scope. A simple fixture replacement might take a few hours to a day. A complete re-wiring and installation of new recessed or pendant lighting throughout a larger kitchen could add 2-3 days of dedicated electrical work to the overall renovation schedule. This work typically occurs after framing and rough-ins, but before drywall installation. We can integrate this work efficiently into your overall construction schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen lighting upgrade can take hours to several days depending on scope. It typically happens after framing and before drywall during a renovation.
